cards.title: Storm
cards.description: Whenever you play a Power, [gold]Channel[/gold] {StormPower:diff()} [gold]Lightning[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh: 每当你打出一张能力牌时，[gold]生成[/gold]{StormPower:diff()}个[gold]闪电[/gold]充能球。

cards.name: Subroutine
cards.title: Subroutine
cards.description: Whenever you play a Power, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
cards.descriptionZh: 当你打出一张能力牌时，获得{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

cards.name: Sunder
cards.title: Sunder
cards.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this kills an enemy, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
cards.descriptionZh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
如果这张牌击杀了敌人，则获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

cards.name: Supercritical
cards.title: Supercritical
cards.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
cards.descriptionZh: 获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

cards.name: SweepingBeam
cards.title: Sweeping Beam
cards.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
cards.descriptionZh:
对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
抽{Cards:diff()}张牌。

cards.name: Synchronize
cards.title: Synchronize
cards.description: Gain {CalculationExtra:diff()} [gold]Focus[/gold] this turn for each unique Orb you have.
cards.descriptionZh: 你每有一种不同的充能球，就在本回合获得{CalculationExtra:diff()}点[gold]集中[/gold]。
dynamicVars:
new CalculatedVar("CalculatedFocus").WithMultiplier((CardModel card, Creature? _) => (from orb in card.Owner.PlayerCombatState.OrbQueue.Orbs
            group orb by orb.Id).Count())

cards.name: Synthesis
cards.title: Synthesis
cards.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
The next Power you play costs 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
cards.descriptionZh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
你打出的下一张能力牌耗能变为0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

cards.name: Tempest
cards.title: Tempest
cards.description: [gold]Channel[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} [gold]Lightning[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh: [gold]生成[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X}个[gold]闪电[/gold]充能球。

cards.name: TeslaCoil
cards.title: Tesla Coil
cards.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Trigger all [gold]Lightning[/gold] against the enemy{IfUpgraded:show: twice|}.
cards.descriptionZh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
对该敌人触发你的所有[gold]闪电[/gold]充能球的被动{IfUpgraded:show:两次|}。

cards.name: Thunder
cards.title: Thunder
cards.description: Whenever you [gold]Evoke Lightning[/gold], deal {ThunderPower:diff()} damage to each enemy hit.
cards.descriptionZh: 每当你[gold]激发闪电[/gold]充能球时，对被命中的敌人造成{ThunderPower:diff()}点伤害。

cards.name: TrashToTreasure
cards.title: Trash to Treasure
cards.description: Whenever you create a Status, [gold]Channel[/gold] 1 random Orb.
cards.descriptionZh: 每当你生成状态牌的时候，随机[gold]生成[/gold]一个充能球。

cards.name: Turbo
cards.title: TURBO
cards.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Add a [gold]Void[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh:
获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。
将一张[gold]虚空[/gold]加入你的[gold]弃牌堆[/gold]。

cards.name: Uproar
cards.title: Uproar
cards.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Play a random Attack from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
cards.descriptionZh:
造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害两次。
随机打出你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中的1张攻击牌。

cards.name: Voltaic
cards.title: Voltaic
cards.description: [gold]Channel Lightning[/gold] equal to the [gold]Lightning[/gold] already [gold]Channeled[/gold] this combat.
cards.descriptionZh: [gold]生成[/gold]等量于你在这场战斗中[gold]生成过[/gold]的[gold]闪电[/gold]充能球数量的[gold]闪电[/gold]充能球。
dynamicVars: new CalculatedVar("CalculatedChannels").WithMultiplier((CardModel card, Creature? _) => CombatManager.Instance.History.Entries.OfType<OrbChanneledEntry>().Count((OrbChanneledEntry e) => e.Actor.Player == card.Owner && e.Orb is LightningOrb))

cards.name: WhiteNoise
cards.title: White Noise
cards.description: Add a random Power into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
cards.descriptionZh: 将一张随机能力牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。这张牌在本回合内免费打出。
